## CombinationsGeneratorConstructorParameters.maxCombinations property

Optional maximum combinations limit to prevent excessive generation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
maxCombinations?: number;
```

## Remarks

This parameter allows configuring a custom limit on the total number of combinations that can be generated. If the calculated total exceeds this limit, a [ConfigurationError](./xpm-lib.configurationerror.md) is thrown to prevent performance issues or memory exhaustion. The default value is 10,000 combinations.
